glossary.label: Provenance
glossary.definition: Recorded relationships between a resource, its inputs and production activities.

glossary.label: Applicability
glossary.definition: Fit between a source’s stated audience or conditions and the proposed use.

glossary.label: Claim support
glossary.definition: Whether the actual source justifies the particular statement being made, not merely whether a citation resolves.

glossary.label: Teaching design
glossary.definition: The objective, activity and teaching format chosen by the author; not automatically validated by a cited source.

glossary.label: Review status
glossary.definition: The actual recorded disposition on an identified resource version, distinct from the source’s own standing.

glossary.label: Uncertainty
glossary.definition: What remains unsettled and which additional observation could change the decision.
